title: Variable Bound Tightening for Nash Equilibrium Computation in Multiplayer Imperfect-Information Games
abstract: arXiv:2606.25997v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: There has been significant recent progress in algorithms for approximation of Nash equilibrium in large two-player zero-sum imperfect-information games and exact computation of Nash equilibrium in multiplayer strategic-form games. While counterfactual regret minimization and fictitious play are scalable to large games and have convergence guarantees in two-player zero-sum games, they do not guarantee convergence to Nash equilibrium in multiplayer games. Recently, an approach has been presented for exact computation of Nash equilibrium in multiplayer imperfect-information games that solves a quadratically constrained program based on a nonlinear complementarity problem formulation derived from the sequence-form game representation. This formulation was solved using Gurobi's nonconvex quadratic solver, which employs spatial branch-and-bound to iteratively refine variable bounds by solving convex relaxations of bilinear terms. translated_title: 多人不完美信息博弈中纳什均衡计算的变量边界收紧方法
translated_abstract: 近年来，在大型二人零和不完美信息博弈的纳什均衡近似算法，以及多人策略式博弈的纳什均衡精确计算方面取得了显著进展。尽管反事实遗憾最小化和虚拟对弈方法可以扩展到大型博弈，并在二人零和博弈中具有收敛保证，但它们无法保证在多人博弈中收敛到纳什均衡。最近，有研究提出了一种精确计算多人不完美信息博弈中纳什均衡的方法，该方法求解一个二次约束规划，该规划基于由序列形式博弈表示导出的非线性互补问题公式化。该公式化使用Gurobi的非凸二次求解器求解，该求解器采用空间分支定界技术，通过求解双线性项的凸松弛来迭代地收紧变量边界。
tldr: 本文提出通过变量边界收紧技术来加速求解多人不完美信息博弈中纳什均衡的二次约束规划，从而提升非凸求解器的计算效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes variable bound tightening techniques to accelerate the exact computation of Nash equilibrium in multiplayer imperfect-information games by enhancing the solving process of the quadratic constrained program with Gurobi's nonconvex solver.
